scope: Vault retrieval only; not an end-to-end deep-research benchmark
baseline: Unmodified production search_fts; production default ranking weights; no quality/embedding scores

candidate.name: or_fallback_on_empty
candidate.rule: Run baseline first. Only when it returns zero results for an unquoted natural-language query without explicit Boolean/NEAR operators, retry its existing preprocessed terms joined by OR. Keep all nonempty baseline results unchanged.

interpretation: A positive result supports testing this retrieval fallback in the product. It does not establish better citation entailment, better full reports, or an official leaderboard ranking.
